# Veto

> sudo for AI agents.

Veto is a guardrail system for AI agent tool calls. It sits between the AI model and tool execution, intercepting and validating every tool call before it runs. Policies are defined in YAML. The agent is unaware it is being governed.

- Website: https://veto.so
- Docs: https://docs.veto.so
- GitHub: https://github.com/PlawIO/veto
- License: Apache-2.0

## Installation

### TypeScript SDK
```bash
npm install veto-sdk
```

### Python SDK
```bash
pip install veto
```

### CLI
```bash
npm install -g veto-cli
```

### Initialize a project
```bash
npx veto init   # creates ./veto/veto.config.yaml + default rules
```

## Core API

### TypeScript

```typescript
import { Veto } from "veto-sdk";

// Initialize from ./veto/veto.config.yaml + rules
const veto = await Veto.init();

// Wrap tools — types preserved, agent unaware
const guarded = veto.wrap(tools);

// Wrap a single tool
const guardedTool = veto.wrapTool(tool);

// Standalone guard check (no tool wrapping)
const result = await veto.guard("transfer_funds", { amount: 5000 });
// result.decision: 'allow' | 'deny' | 'require_approval'
```

### Python

```python
from veto import Veto

veto = await Veto.init()

# Wrap tools
guarded = veto.wrap(my_tools)

# Standalone guard check
result = await veto.guard("transfer_funds", {"amount": 5000})
```

### Veto.init() options

```typescript
const veto = await Veto.init({
  configDir: "./veto",         // path to config directory
  mode: "strict",              // "strict" | "log" | "shadow"
  validationMode: "local",     // "local" | "api" | "kernel" | "custom" | "cloud"
  logLevel: "info",            // "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error" | "silent"
});
```

### GuardContext

Pass per-call context to `guard()`:

```typescript
const result = await veto.guard("purchase", { item: "GPU" }, {
  sessionId: "sess-123",
  agentId: "trading-bot",
  userId: "user-456",
  economic: {
    cost: 42.5,
    currency: "USD",
    payer: "team-wallet",
    protocol: "custom",
  },
});
```

## Configuration: veto.config.yaml

```yaml
version: "1.0"
name: my-policy
description: Production guardrails

settings:
  default_action: allow    # action when no rules match
  fail_mode: closed        # "open" (allow on error) or "closed" (block on error)

rules:
  - id: block-large-transfers
    name: Block transfers over $1,000
    enabled: true
    severity: high
    action: block
    tools: [transfer_funds]
    conditions:
      - field: arguments.amount
        operator: greater_than
        value: 1000

output_rules:
  - id: redact-ssn
    name: Redact SSNs from output
    enabled: true
    severity: critical
    action: redact
    redact_with: "[REDACTED]"
    output_conditions:
      - field: output
        operator: matches
        value: "\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}"
```

## Rule YAML format

### Rule fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Unique identifier |
| `name` | string | Human-readable name |
| `description` | string | Optional detailed description |
| `enabled` | boolean | Whether the rule is active |
| `severity` | string | `critical` / `high` / `medium` / `low` / `info` |
| `action` | string | What to do when conditions match (see Actions below) |
| `tools` | string[] | Tools this rule applies to (empty = all tools) |
| `agents` | string[] or `{ not: string[] }` | Agent scope filter |
| `conditions` | RuleCondition[] | AND logic conditions |
| `condition_groups` | RuleCondition[][] | OR logic between groups |
| `blocked_by` | SequenceConstraint[] | Trigger if a matching historical call exists |
| `requires` | SequenceConstraint[] | Trigger if a required historical call is missing |
| `rate_limits` | RateLimitEntry[] | Sliding window rate limits |
| `tags` | string[] | Categorization tags |
| `metadata` | object | Arbitrary metadata |

### Actions

| Action | Behavior |
|--------|----------|
| `block` | Deny the tool call with a reason |
| `allow` | Permit the tool call |
| `warn` | Allow but log a warning |
| `log` | Allow and log the decision |
| `require_approval` | Route to human approval queue (aliased as `ask` in shorthand) |
| `require_payment` | Gate behind a payment protocol (x402, MPP, AP2) |

### Condition operators

| Operator | Description | Example value |
|----------|-------------|---------------|
| `equals` | Exact match | `"production"` |
| `not_equals` | Not equal | `"staging"` |
| `contains` | Substring match | `"admin"` |
| `not_contains` | No substring match | `"test"` |
| `starts_with` | Prefix match | `"/etc/"` |
| `ends_with` | Suffix match | `".env"` |
| `matches` | Regex match | `"\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}"` |
| `greater_than` | Numeric greater than | `1000` |
| `less_than` | Numeric less than | `0` |
| `length_greater_than` | String/array length check | `100` |
| `in` | Value in list | `["main", "master"]` |
| `not_in` | Value not in list | `["dev", "staging"]` |
| `within_hours` | Time window (allow during hours) | `{ start: "09:00", end: "17:00", timezone: "America/New_York" }` |
| `outside_hours` | Time window (block during hours) | `{ start: "22:00", end: "06:00", timezone: "UTC" }` |
| `percent_of` | Percentage of a reference field | Used with `reference` field |

### Condition examples

```yaml
conditions:
  # Simple field comparison
  - field: arguments.amount
    operator: greater_than
    value: 1000

  # List membership
  - field: arguments.branch
    operator: in
    value: ["main", "master", "production"]

  # Regex match
  - field: arguments.path
    operator: matches
    value: "\\.(env|key|pem)$"

  # Time window
  - field: _time
    operator: outside_hours
    value:
      start: "09:00"
      end: "17:00"
      timezone: "America/New_York"
      days: [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri]

  # Compiled expression (alternative to field/operator/value)
  - expression: "args.amount > 500 && args.currency == 'USD'"
```

### Sequence constraints

```yaml
rules:
  - id: require-auth-before-transfer
    name: Must authenticate before transferring
    action: block
    tools: [transfer_funds]
    requires:
      - tool: authenticate
        within: 300  # seconds
        conditions:
          - field: arguments.status
            operator: equals
            value: "success"
```

## Provider adapters

Convert between Veto's internal tool format and provider-specific formats.

### TypeScript

```typescript
import {
  toOpenAITools, fromOpenAI, fromOpenAIToolCall,
  toAnthropicTools, fromAnthropic, fromAnthropicToolUse,
  toGoogleTool, fromGoogleFunctionCall,
  toMCPTools, fromMCP, fromMCPToolCall,
} from "veto-sdk";

// Convert Veto tool definitions to OpenAI format
const openaiTools = toOpenAITools(definitions);

// Convert OpenAI tool call back to Veto format
const vetoCall = fromOpenAIToolCall(openaiToolCall);
```

### Python

```python
from veto import (
    to_openai_tools, from_openai, from_openai_tool_call,
    to_anthropic_tools, from_anthropic, from_anthropic_tool_use,
    to_google_tool, from_google_function_call,
)
```

Supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (Gemini), MCP (Model Context Protocol).

## Rate limiting

Per-rule sliding window rate limits. In-memory by default, Redis-backed for distributed deployments.

### YAML

```yaml
rules:
  - id: rate-limit-api-calls
    name: Limit API calls
    action: block
    tools: [call_api]
    rate_limits:
      - scope: user       # agent | user | session | global
        max_calls: 10
        window_seconds: 60
```

### Redis store (TypeScript)

```typescript
import { RedisRateLimitStore } from "veto-sdk";
import { createClient } from "redis";

const redis = createClient();
await redis.connect();
const store = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, "veto:rl:");
```

### Python

```python
from veto import evaluate_rate_limits, RateLimitStore
```

The `RateLimitStore` interface requires two methods: `checkAndRecord(key, maxCalls, windowMs)` and `clear()`. Implement this interface for any backing store.

## Audit chain

Tamper-evident append-only audit trail. Each record's hash is computed over the previous hash plus the record's deterministic JSON serialization (sorted keys). Mutating any historical record invalidates all subsequent hashes.

### TypeScript

```typescript
import { computeChainHash, GENESIS_HASH } from "veto-sdk";

let prevHash = GENESIS_HASH; // empty string for first record
const record = { tool: "transfer_funds", decision: "allow", timestamp: "..." };
const hash = computeChainHash(prevHash, record);
// hash is SHA-256 hex digest
```

### Python

```python
from veto import compute_chain_hash, GENESIS_HASH

prev_hash = GENESIS_HASH
record = {"tool": "transfer_funds", "decision": "allow"}
hash = compute_chain_hash(prev_hash, record)
```

Verify chain integrity with the CLI:

```bash
npx veto-cli audit verify
```

## OpenTelemetry

Optional `@opentelemetry/api` peer dependency. Zero overhead when not installed -- all functions return no-ops.

### TypeScript

```typescript
import { tryLoadOtel } from "veto-sdk";

const tracer = await tryLoadOtel("my-service");
const span = tracer.startSpan("veto.guard");
span.setAttribute("tool", "transfer_funds");
span.end();
```

### Python

```python
from veto import try_load_otel, VetoTracer, VetoSpan
```

When `@opentelemetry/api` (TS) or `opentelemetry-api` (Python) is installed, Veto automatically instruments guard checks with spans.

## Policy testing

YAML fixture files in `./veto/tests/`. Deterministic replay -- no LLM, no network.

### Fixture format

```yaml
suite: Transfer rules
tests:
  - id: block-large-transfer
    description: Blocks transfers over $1,000
    tool: transfer_funds
    arguments:
      amount: 5000
      recipient: "alice"
    expect:
      decision: block
      rule_id: block-large-transfers

  - id: allow-small-transfer
    description: Allows transfers under $1,000
    tool: transfer_funds
    arguments:
      amount: 100
    expect:
      decision: allow
```

### TypeScript

```typescript
import { runTests } from "veto-sdk";

const result = await runTests({
  fixturesPath: "./veto/tests",
  policyPath: "./veto",
  coverage: true,
});
// result.passed, result.failed, result.results
```

### Python

```python
from veto import run_tests
result = await run_tests(fixtures_path="./veto/tests")
```

### CLI

```bash
npx veto-cli test                          # run all fixtures
npx veto-cli test --coverage              # show untested rule IDs
npx veto-cli test --fixtures ./custom/dir  # custom fixture path
```

## SSE proxy

HTTP proxy that intercepts OpenAI and Anthropic streaming (SSE) responses, validates tool calls against Veto policies before forwarding to the client. Supports both OpenAI and Anthropic SSE formats with auto-detection.

### TypeScript

```typescript
import { startProxyServer } from "veto-sdk/proxy";

const stop = await startProxyServer({
  port: 8080,
  target: "https://api.openai.com",
  configDir: "./veto",
  format: "auto",        // "openai" | "anthropic" | "auto"
  maxBufferBytes: 1_048_576,
});
```

### CLI

```bash
npx veto-cli intercept --port 8080 --target https://api.openai.com
npx veto-cli intercept --target https://api.anthropic.com --format anthropic
```

Point your application at `http://localhost:8080` instead of the provider URL. Tool calls in streamed responses are buffered, validated, and either forwarded or replaced with a synthetic block event.

## Webhooks

Event notifications for decisions, blocks, and approvals.

### Supported formats

| Format | Function (TS) | Function (Python) |
|--------|--------------|-------------------|
| Slack | `formatSlackPayload()` | `format_slack_payload()` |
| PagerDuty | `formatPagerDutyPayload()` | `format_pagerduty_payload()` |
| Generic JSON | `formatGenericPayload()` | `format_generic_payload()` |
| CEF (ArcSight) | `formatCefPayload()` | `format_cef_payload()` |

### Configuration

```typescript
import { resolveEventWebhookConfig, formatSlackPayload } from "veto-sdk";
```

Webhook event types: `tool_call_blocked`, `tool_call_allowed`, `approval_requested`, `approval_resolved`, `rate_limit_exceeded`, `budget_exceeded`.

## Output patterns

Built-in regex patterns for detecting sensitive data in tool outputs.

```typescript
import {
  OUTPUT_PATTERNS,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_SSN,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_CREDIT_CARD,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_OPENAI_API_KEY,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_GITHUB_API_KEY,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_AWS_API_KEY,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_EMAIL,
  OUTPUT_PATTERN_US_PHONE,
} from "veto-sdk";
```

These are reference patterns, not auto-applied. Use them in output rules:

```yaml
output_rules:
  - id: redact-credit-cards
    name: Redact credit card numbers
    enabled: true
    severity: critical
    action: redact
    redact_with: "[REDACTED]"
    output_conditions:
      - field: output
        operator: matches
        value: "\\b\\d{4}[- ]?\\d{4}[- ]?\\d{4}[- ]?\\d{4}\\b"
```

## VetoAdmin

Management API client for Veto Cloud. Manages policies, decisions, approvals, API keys, and MCP upstreams.

```typescript
import { VetoAdmin } from "veto-sdk";

const admin = new VetoAdmin({ apiKey: process.env.VETO_API_KEY });

// Policies
const policies = await admin.listPolicies();
await admin.createPolicy({ toolName: "transfer_funds", constraints: [...] });

// Decisions
const decisions = await admin.listDecisions({ tool: "transfer_funds" });
const stats = await admin.getDecisionStats();

// Approvals
const pending = await admin.listApprovals({ status: "pending" });
await admin.resolveApproval(approvalId, { decision: "approve" });
```

## VetoCloudClient

Validation client for Veto Cloud. Handles tool registration, validation requests, and approval polling.

```typescript
import { VetoCloudClient } from "veto-sdk";

const client = new VetoCloudClient({
  apiKey: process.env.VETO_API_KEY,
  baseUrl: "https://api.veto.so",
});
```

```python
from veto import VetoCloudClient, VetoCloudConfig
```

## Economic authorization

Cost-aware policy enforcement for agents that spend money.

### Protocol connectors

| Protocol | Connector (TS) | Description |
|----------|----------------|-------------|
| x402 | `createX402Connector()` | HTTP 402 / EVM L2 payments |
| Stripe MPP | `createMPPConnector()` | Stripe Managed Payment Platform |
| Google AP2 | `createAP2Connector()` | Google Automated Payment Platform |

### Usage

```typescript
import { createX402Connector, EconomicEvaluator, LocalBudgetEngine } from "veto-sdk";

const connector = createX402Connector({ chainId: 8453, currency: "USDC" });
const budget = new LocalBudgetEngine();
const evaluator = new EconomicEvaluator(budget, connector);
```

### YAML shorthand

```yaml
extends: "@veto/economic-agent"
```

### Guard with economic context

```typescript
const result = await veto.guard("purchase", { item: "GPU" }, {
  economic: {
    cost: 42.5,
    currency: "USD",
    payer: "team-wallet",
    protocol: "custom",
  },
});
```

## Compiler

AST-based policy expressions as an alternative to field/operator/value conditions.

```typescript
import { compile, evaluate, typeCheck } from "veto-sdk";

const ast = compile("args.amount > 500 && args.currency == 'USD'");
const result = evaluate(ast, { args: { amount: 600, currency: "USD" } });
// result: true
```

Use in YAML rules:

```yaml
conditions:
  - expression: "args.amount > 500 && args.currency == 'USD'"
```

## CLI commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `veto init` | Initialize project with config and default rules |
| `veto studio` | Launch interactive TUI |
| `veto policy generate` | Generate policy YAML from natural language |
| `veto policy apply` | Apply a policy file |
| `veto guard check` | Check a tool call against rules |
| `veto test` | Run policy test fixtures |
| `veto scan` | Audit tool coverage, exit 1 on gaps (`--fail-uncovered`) |
| `veto diff` | Show policy diff between branches/versions |
| `veto intercept` | Start SSE proxy server |
| `veto mcp serve` | Serve tools as MCP server |
| `veto learn` | Learn rules from tool call history |
| `veto compile` | Compile policy expressions to AST |
| `veto replay` | Replay recorded tool calls against policies |
| `veto repl` | Interactive policy REPL |
| `veto audit verify` | Verify audit chain integrity |
| `veto cloud login` | Authenticate with Veto Cloud |
| `veto cloud whoami` | Show current cloud identity |
| `veto doctor` | Diagnose configuration issues |

## Human-in-the-loop

Route sensitive decisions to human approval instead of auto-blocking.

### YAML

```yaml
rules:
  - id: approve-prod-deploy
    name: Require approval for production deploys
    action: require_approval    # or "ask" as shorthand
    tools: [deploy]
    conditions:
      - field: arguments.environment
        operator: equals
        value: "production"
```

### Polling for approval

```typescript
const result = await veto.guard("deploy", { environment: "production" });
if (result.decision === "require_approval") {
  // result contains approval metadata
  // Poll or webhook for resolution
}
```

Approval workflows are available locally (CLI studio) and at scale via Veto Cloud dashboard.

## Modes

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| `strict` | Block tool calls when validation fails |
| `log` | Log failures but allow all tool calls |
| `shadow` | Compute real decisions but never block |

## Validation modes

| Mode | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `local` | Evaluate YAML rules locally with deterministic checks (default) |
| `api` | External HTTP API for validation |
| `kernel` | Local kernel model via Ollama |
| `custom` | Custom LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter) |
| `cloud` | Veto Cloud API with approval workflow |
